title: Isometric/3D
content: Apply isometric/3D design with dimensional elements. Use isometric grid perspective (30-degree angles). Create 3D box-like cards with visible sides using CSS transforms (rotateX, rotateY). Add isometric illustrations for visuals. Color: use shading to show 3D form - darker sides, lighter tops. Include drop shadows suggesting elevation. Layered elements creating depth. Floating elements with perspective. CSS 3D transforms for interactive depth effects.

variants.simple: Create depth with isometric 3D illustrations and pseudo-3D UI elements.
variants.detailed: Apply isometric/3D design with dimensional elements. Use isometric grid perspective (30-degree angles). Create 3D box-like cards with visible sides using CSS transforms (rotateX, rotateY). Add isometric illustrations for visuals. Color: use shading to show 3D form - darker sides, lighter tops. Include drop shadows suggesting elevation. Layered elements creating depth. Floating elements with perspective. CSS 3D transforms for interactive depth effects.
variants.advanced: Apply isometric/3D design creating dimensional, spatial interfaces. Isometric foundation: 30-degree angle grid system, objects shown from consistent viewpoint. 3D cards: use CSS transforms - transform: rotateX(-10deg) rotateY(10deg) for subtle tilt, or full isometric with perspective parent. Box construction: visible top, left, and right faces using pseudo-elements or stacked divs with transforms; each face different shade (top lightest, right medium, left darkest). Color shading: simulate light source from top-left; use HSL color manipulation for consistent shading (same hue, varying lightness). Shadow system: layered shadows (shadow-sm on close elements, shadow-xl on raised), consider colored shadows matching element. Floating elements: translate3d and scale creating hierarchy levels, parallax on scroll. Isometric illustrations: SVG icons and images in isometric style, consistent angle throughout. Depth layers: clear foreground, midground, background separation using z-index and transforms. Interactive: hover states that rotate or lift elements further (translateZ), smooth transitions. Grid: isometric grid background pattern as subtle guide. Typography: remains flat and readable, not perspective-warped. Performance: use transform3d for GPU acceleration, will-change for animated elements. Reduce complexity on mobile. Accessibility: ensure depth cues are decorative not meaningful, maintain flat reading order for screen readers. 3D should enhance not confuse interaction models.
